modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Trunk shifts forward over the planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts backward over the planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Trunk shifts left over the planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts right over the planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Trunk lowers between the planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk rises above the planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_left_up
modes.plus: Trunk rolls with its left side rising.
modes.minus: Trunk rolls with its right side rising.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along roll

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Trunk rotates left over the planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk rotates right over the planted feet.

modes.name: l0_tip_outward

modes.minus: Tip moves right and upward toward its root.
